evidence.title: F1 Brazilian Grand Prix results CHANGED as FIA announce post-race penalties
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Lando Norris took his third win of the season in style in Sao Paulo, battling changing conditions with ease. [e005:f02] The McLaren star won a race which both started and ended in the rain, with a long dry period in the intervening laps to challenge every facet of the drivers' and teams' abilities. [e005:f03] There was a post-race reshuffle behind the trophy winners though, with some late time penalties being handed down by the stewards. [e005:f04] Charles Leclerc finished seventh on the road after an aggressive late overtake on Liam Lawson, but was demoted to eighth after being handed a five-second time penalty for causing a collision in the hours following the chequered flag. [e005:f05] That penalty was for effectively punting Lawson out of his way to get past. [e005:f06] There were two more penalties handed out post-race, both of them for unsafe releases in the pit lane in a late round of hurried stops when the rain returned. [e005:f07] Fifth-placed finisher Kimi Antonelli and 17th-placed Ollie Bearman both picked up five-second penalties for those infringements, but neither of them lost any places as a result. [e005:f08] F1 HEADLINES: Max Verstappen slams 'disaster' Red Bull as Liam Lawson contract decision savaged F1 Results: Brazilian Grand Prix 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix Race Results Pos Driver Team Gap 1 Lando Norris McLaren WINNER 2 Max Verstappen Red Bull +14.602s 3 Isack Hadjar Red Bull +24.485s 4 George Russell Mercedes +33.991s 5 Kimi Antonelli* Mercedes +41.017s 6 Oscar Piastri McLaren +56.475s 7 Liam Lawson Racing Bulls +1:15.402s 8 Charles Leclerc ** Ferrari +1:18.586s 9 Lewis Hamilton Ferrari +1 LAP 10 Nico Hulkenberg Audi +1 LAP 11 Arvid Lindblad Racing Bulls +1 LAP 12 Fernando Alonso Aston Martin +1 LAP 13 Franco Colapinto Alpine +1 LAP 14 Pierre Gasly Alpine +1 LAP 15 Alex Albon Williams +1 LAP 16 Gabriel Bortoleto Audi +1 LAP 17 Oliver Bearman*** Haas +1 LAP 18 Sergio Perez Cadillac +1 LAP 19 Carlos Sainz Williams +2 LAPS 20 Rafael Camara Haas +2 LAPS NC Lance Stroll Aston Martin DNF NC Valtteri Bottas Cadillac DNS *Kimi Antonelli took a five-second penalty for an unsafe release. **Charles Leclerc dropped from seventh to eighth post-race thanks to a five-second penalty for causing a collision with Liam Lawson. ***Ollie Bearman took a five-second penalty for an unsafe release. [e005:f09] The 2026 F1 calendar has an off-week next up, before heading to the United States for the third time this season. [e005:f10] The Las Vegas Grand Prix will, in theory, kick off a season-closing triple-header which will also take in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, although the latter two races are still in ever-so slight doubt due to ongoing conflict in the region. [e005:f11] With the drivers' and constructors' championships now wrapped up, attention will be focused on the five-way battle to finish as runner-up to Kimi Antonelli, as well as Red Bull and McLaren's scrap to secure the prize money for finishing third in the team standings.

evidence.title: Piastri and management team mutually terminate agreement
Honda Investing $3B to Build New Plant in Ohio
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Located near Honda's existing Ohio manufacturing operations, the automaker expects the new facility to begin production in 2029, pending final government approvals. [e003:f02] The new plant represents a broader set of investments at Honda operations in Ohio, Alabama and Georgia designed to expand and strengthen an integrated U.S. production network to boost production of hybrid-electric vehicles and the engines and hybrid systems that power them. [e003:f03] These investments will establish the foundation for next-generation production capabilities and help meet growing customer demand for Honda and Acura products, including hybrid-electric vehicles and multiple new models currently under development by Honda R&D operations in the U.S. [e003:f04] In May 2026, Honda announced plans to introduce 15 new Honda and Acura hybrid models globally by 2030, with North America expected to be the primary market for many of those vehicles. [e003:f05] Together, the new Ohio plant and projects underway at existing Honda facilities will create an integrated manufacturing network for future hybrid and gasoline-powered vehicles, connecting vehicle assembly with expanded engine and hybrid system production. [e003:f06] Key projects across the Honda manufacturing network in North America include: ### All-New Ohio Plant The new Honda auto plant in Ohio will be located on land between the company’s existing East Liberty and Marysville Auto Plants. [e003:f07] It will be the fourth auto plant in Ohio and Honda’s ninth auto-related production facility in the U.S. [e003:f08] Honda selected Ohio based on multiple factors, including close proximity to a large concentration of the company’s U.S. supply base, nearby vehicle development operations, including the adjacent Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, the North American Automotive Development Center (ADC) and the Transportation Research Center (TRC), existing Honda manufacturing operations for vehicles, engines and hybrid systems and the L-H Battery Company joint venture facility, which will have the flexibility to produce battery cells for both hybrid and all-electric vehicles. ### Alabama Auto/Engine Plant Honda is investing in its Alabama Auto Plant (AAP), which will mark the 25th anniversary of vehicle production this fall, to increase production capacity and expand engine production for a new V6 hybrid engine. [e003:f09] The investment will renew key vehicle and engine production operations and include one of the most significant renovations of Line 1 since the plant began production in 2001. [e003:f10] These changes will add flexibility to build multiple vehicle models on the company’s two vehicle production lines and strengthen the plant’s role in the future Honda hybrid vehicle strategy. * Retooling the AAP engine production facility includes the addition of new equipment for production of a new V6 hybrid engine and expanding production capacity. * Retooling for vehicle production includes infrastructure updates on Line 1 that will enable the line to produce the Passport, which is currently built only on Line 2. [e003:f11] This includes innovation activities across the plant in production and quality areas, helping to increase capacity, flexibility and overall operational efficiency. ### Anna Engine Plant (AEP) in Ohio Honda is undertaking major retooling of existing engine production equipment at the Anna Engine Plant (AEP), the largest Honda engine plant in the world, as well as establishing a parts consolidation center to support production. * AEP is retooling an existing production line to produce a next-generation 4-cylinder Atkinson-cycle engine for future compact and midsize vehicles built in North America. * AEP is expanding a new on-site parts consolidation center, expected to begin operation next year, that will improve logistics efficiency and support future production growth. ### Hybrid System Production in Ohio and Georgia **Ohio:**Honda has begun retooling the Honda Transmission Plant-Ohio (TMP-O) to support production of two next-generation Honda Hybrid systems for both compact and midsize vehicles as well as larger models built in North America, increasing production capacity of hybrid systems by 250% in the coming years. * The project transforms an existing transmission production line into a second hybrid system line even as the plant continues to support current vehicle production. * TMP-O has been producing a two-motor hybrid system for Honda vehicles made in the U.S. including CR-V, Accord and Civic. [e003:f12] TMP-O also will serve as the lead plant for this larger system. **Georgia:**Honda Transmission Plant-Georgia (TMP-G) will begin production of next-generation hybrid systems for larger vehicles in the coming years. * TMP-G currently makes the 10-speed automatic transmission for Honda and Acura models made in Alabama and Ohio. * The hybrid system project will require the Georgia plant to install a new transmission assembly production line. [e003:f13] Designers and engineers at ADC operations in California and Ohio are currently developing multiple new models for the Honda and Acura brands. [e003:f14] The proximity of the vehicle development center to Honda manufacturing operations in the U.S. enables Honda manufacturing and R&D engineers to work closely together from the early stages of development to improve manufacturability, quality and efficiency for new model launches. ### Honda of Canada Mfg. [e003:f15] After 40 years of vehicle production in Canada, Honda will invest in updates and retooling of production operations at Honda of Canada Mfg. in Alliston, Ontario, to support production of next-generation hybrid-electric and gasoline-powered models, including the reintroduction of engine manufacturing. [e003:f16] The project will include future planned investments and related expenses, while enhancing quality, efficiency and manufacturing flexibility. ### Honda Manufacturing in North America In 2025, nearly 99% of all Honda and Acura automobiles sold in the U.S. were made in North America.

evidence.title: Leclerc called to stewards twice as FIA investigates three São Paulo GP incidents
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Charles Leclerc and Liam Lawson were called in over contact at Junção. [e006:f02] The stewards also summoned Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Franco Colapinto and Oliver Bearman over two separate pit-lane incidents. [e006:f03] The Ferrari driver and Liam Lawson were called in over contact at Turn 12, while a separate hearing concerns a possible unsafe release by Haas involving Oliver Bearman and Leclerc. [e006:f04] Andrea Kimi Antonelli and Franco Colapinto were called in over a possible unsafe release from the Mercedes pit box. [e006:f05] Oliver Bearman and Leclerc were summoned over a separate possible unsafe release involving Haas. [e006:f06] The published notices are summonses, with decisions on the three incidents still pending at the time of writing. [e006:f07] Charles Leclerc was summoned twice after the São Paulo Grand Prix as the FIA stewards opened three post-race cases at Interlagos. [e006:f08] The stewards also called in Andrea Kimi Antonelli and Franco Colapinto over an incident in the pit lane. [e006:f09] Leclerc and Lawson called in over contact at Junção The stewards scheduled the hearing for 16:45 local time , citing contact between the Ferrari and Racing Bulls at Turn 12. [e006:f10] Leclerc was classified seventh in the provisional result, 1.816s ahead of Lawson . [e006:f11] Mercedes and Haas face separate pit-lane hearings The stewards scheduled Antonelli and Colapinto’s hearing for 16:30 local time . [e006:f12] The case concerns the release of Antonelli’s Mercedes into the pit lane in an incident involving Colapinto’s Alpine. [e006:f13] That fifth place, together with George Russell’s fourth, was enough for Mercedes to secure the constructors’ title in the provisional São Paulo GP result . [e006:f14] Bearman and Leclerc were called in for 17:15 local time over a different incident. [e006:f15] The stewards’ notices identify Bearman’s Haas as the car released and summon Leclerc in connection with that release. [e006:f16] GRANDE PRÊMIO is following every session of the São Paulo Grand Prix in Formula 1 live from Interlagos.

evidence.title: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix announces pre-race music line-up
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Steve Aoki, MORTEN and Jordin Sparks will headline the pre-race entertainment at the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix American DJ Steve Aoki will return to the Las Vegas Grand Prix grid this year for a performance before the race on 21 November. [e001:f02] He will be joined by fellow DJ MORTEN and singer Jordin Sparks as part of the pre-race line-up. [e001:f03] MORTEN will perform ahead of the driver introductions, which have become a fan-favourite part of the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend after the viral moment between Sergio Perez and Bruce Buffer. [e001:f04] Following this, Sparks will sing the national anthem before the race. [e001:f05] The American Idol season six winner, known for "No Air" and "Tattoo", was also chosen to sing it at this year's Indianapolis 500. [e001:f06] Las Vegas Grand Prix president and CEO Emily Prazer explained the music was meant to be part of the event rather than an added attraction. [e001:f07] "We want every part of the Las Vegas Grand Prix to feel distinctly Las Vegas – from the anticipation on the grid to the moment the cars take off," she said. [e001:f08] "By bringing together world-class musical talent and the thrill of Formula 1, we are creating an atmosphere that captures the spirit of the city. [e001:f09] Not every ticket holder will see the pre-race grid performances. [e001:f10] Organisers say views of some of the acts come with the Heineken Silver Main Grandstand, Skybox and Trackside Tavern, as well as the Paddock Club, Wynn Grid Club and Gordon Ramsay at F1 Garage. [e001:f11] Other entertainment acts at the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix The Paddock Club will also feature entertainment from mentalist Colin Cloud and the cast of Now You See Me Live, the illusion show inspired by the film series. [e001:f12] The Wynn Grid Club will also have Love Island USA season eight cast member Bryce Alakai do a DJ set on race night. [e001:f13] The T-Mobile Stage at Sphere acts include Sean Paul, Disclosure, Two Friends, Natasha Bedingfield, Gorgon City and Ja Rule. [e001:f14] The Backstreet Boys will play the first F1 Afterparty at Sphere. [e001:f15] The Heineken Stage acts include Disco Dom, Icona Pop and The Australian Bee Gees Show.

evidence.title: George Russell teases imminent karting announcement as F1 fans spot major clue
evidence.body: [e002:f01] George Russell has teased a karting-related announcement for 12 November, leading to speculation that he could be launching his own racing academy George Russell has teased an imminent announcement linked to karting on 12 November. [e002:f02] The Mercedes driver posted a video to Instagram on Monday with the caption "Stay tuned". [e002:f03] He talks about his first steps in motorsport over footage of himself racing karts as a boy, including a kart carrying the number 63 that he still uses in Formula 1. [e002:f04] The clip ends with the date 12.11.26, suggesting more will be revealed on Thursday. [e002:f05] "Karting was such a huge part of my life. [e002:f06] I grew up on the racetrack as my older brother Benjy was a go-kart driver before me, but I started karting properly when I was seven years old," the 28-year-old said. [e002:f07] "I loved it from the very beginning. [e002:f08] I remember the pure adrenaline I got from racing go-karts. [e002:f09] I just knew I wanted to be a racing driver. [e002:f10] "Karting taught me the fundamentals of racing and refined me into the driver that I am right now. [e002:f11] Now it’s time to give back to a sport that gave me so much." While Russell is yet to announce any further details, multiple fans in the comments questioned whether the Briton could be announcing a karting team. [e002:f12] The post was shared in collaboration with a new Instagram account called "gr63academy", which suggests those fans could be correct. [e002:f13] Mercedes secured the constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix, but Russell had been left frustrated after missing out on pole position and a podium finish. [e002:f14] After starting seventh due to a five-place grid penalty, Russell finished fourth at Interlagos. [e002:f15] He currently sits third in the drivers' standings with 262 points, behind second-placed Max Verstappen on 279 points. [e002:f16] Lewis Hamilton follows in fourth with 261 points, and Charles Leclerc is fifth with 249 points.

evidence.title: Honda announces $3 billion plant investment near East Liberty
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 9, 2026 at 6:45 PM EST | Updated : 10 hours ago Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MARYSVILLE, Ohio (WLIO) — Honda plans to invest $3 billion in a new plant next to its East Liberty facility, a project expected to create more than 2,000 jobs. [e003:f02] The new plant, located near Honda’s existing Ohio manufacturing operations, is expected to begin production in 2029, pending final government approvals. [e003:f03] Once operational, it will increase Honda’s U.S. production to 1.3 million vehicles per year. [e003:f04] Honda is also investing in the Anna Engine Plant and its transmission plant in Russells Point to support increased hybrid production. [e003:f05] In May, the automaker announced plans to introduce 15 new Honda and Acura hybrid models worldwide by 2030. [e003:f06] Media Release from Honda of America November 9, 2026 — MARYSVILLE, Ohio New $3 billion Ohio auto plant will create more than 2,000 new American jobs and capacity to build an additional 240,000 vehicles a year, with production expected to begin in 2029 Strategic investments in Honda’s North American manufacturing facilities will strengthen comprehensive production network and boost hybrid production Investments at Honda plants in Ohio, Alabama, Georgia will expand U.S. production of hybrid-electric vehicles, engines and hybrid systems Multiple new models currently under development at Honda R&D in the U.S. to meet growing customer demand Honda’s U.S. auto production capacity will grow to approximately 1.3 million vehicles a year; hybrid powertrain production capacity in Ohio will increase 250 percent To meet growing customer demand for hybrid vehicles in North America, Honda today announced it will invest $3 billion to build a new auto plant in Central Ohio, creating more than 2,000 new American jobs and increasing its U.S. auto production capacity to approximately 1.3 million vehicles a year. [e003:f07] The new plant is a part of a broader set of investments at Honda operations in Ohio, Alabama and Georgia that will expand and strengthen an integrated U.S. production network to boost production of hybrid-electric vehicles and the engines and hybrid systems that power them. [e003:f08] By expanding our comprehensive R&D and manufacturing capabilities, we will be better positioned to serve our customers and contribute to the economic vitality of the communities where we operate.” Reflecting Honda’s longstanding approach of building products close to its customers, as well as confidence in the region’s workforce, innovation and long-term growth potential, these substantial investments will establish the foundation for next-generation production capabilities and help meet growing customer demand for Honda and Acura products, including hybrid-electric vehicles and multiple new models currently under development by Honda R&D operations in the U.S. [e003:f09] In May 2026, Honda announced plans to introduce 15 new Honda and Acura hybrid models globally by 2030, with North America expected to be the primary market for many of those vehicles. [e003:f10] Key projects across the Honda manufacturing network in North America include: All-New Ohio Plant The new Honda auto plant in Ohio will be located on land between the company’s existing East Liberty and Marysville Auto Plants. [e003:f11] It will be the 4th auto plant in Ohio and Honda’s 9th auto-related production facility in the U.S. [e003:f12] The new Ohio Honda plant will be one of the most advanced in the world when it comes online in 2029 with leading-edge automation, data-driven technologies and flexible production systems to improve efficiency, quality and competitiveness. [e003:f13] Today’s announcement isn’t just an investment in a new facility - it’s an investment in Ohio’s people and Ohio’s future.” Ohio was selected for the new auto plant based on a number of factors, including an established highly skilled workforce; close proximity to a large concentration of the company’s U.S. supply base; nearby vehicle development operations, including the adjacent Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, the North American Automotive Development Center (ADC) and the Transportation Research Center (TRC); existing Honda manufacturing operations for vehicles, engines and hybrid systems; and the L-H Battery Company joint venture facility, which will have the flexibility to produce battery cells for both hybrid and all-electric vehicles. [e003:f14] In addition, Honda has been a major supporter of the advancement of academic and workforce programs related to engineering and manufacturing capabilities in Ohio over the past four decades, including investment of $132 million in research facilities and endowed chairs at The Ohio State University, in addition to regional work-study partnerships with two-year academic institutions like Columbus State. [e003:f15] Alabama Auto/Engine Plant Honda is investing in its Alabama Auto Plant (AAP), which will mark the 25th anniversary of vehicle production this fall, to increase production capacity and expand engine production for a new V6 hybrid engine. [e003:f16] The investment will renew key vehicle and engine production operations and include one of the most significant renovations of Line 1 since the plant began production in 2001.

evidence.title: Two Spirits in Motion: Aston Martin and Glenfiddich release limited edition 28 year old Single Malt
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Apparently, you put it on a whisky bottle. [e004:f02] The whisky goes on sale in January 2027 in the United States and at select international airports. [e004:f03] Neither brand has published pricing or bottle numbers in the material released so far. [e004:f04] The collaboration began at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix in 2024. [e004:f05] Since then, the pair have built a growing collection of limited edition bottles, and this 28 year old release is the newest addition. [e004:f06] Car makers have lent their badges to lifestyle products for a long time, and Aston Martin frames this one around shared British heritage. [e004:f07] Glenfiddich Malt Master Brian Kinsman combined several oak influences to shape the final whisky. [e004:f08] According to the distillery, that second stage brings out vanilla and spice. [e004:f09] Two more cask types complete the recipe: The European oak Oloroso sherry-seasoned casks add further depth of flavour, and then the traditional ex-bourbon casks bring the orchard fruit notes Glenfiddich is known for. [e004:f10] Podium Green and Copper Aston Martin’s design team worked with Glenfiddich on the packaging. [e004:f11] It pairs Podium Green with copper accents and the distillery’s familiar stag emblem, with the design drawing on the flowing bodywork of Aston Martin’s supercars and hypercars. [e004:f12] When this whisky first went into casks in the late 1990s, Aston Martin was developing Project Vantage, the concept that eventually became the Vanquish. [e004:f13] So the liquid started ageing just as Aston Martin was shaping the car that would open its next chapter. [e004:f14] Still, it shows how Aston Martin uses its British identity, and the F1 stage where this partnership began, to reach people well beyond the showroom. [e004:f15] For collectors, the 28 year age statement is the main appeal. [e004:f16] A whisky laid down while the Vanquish was still a concept now arrives in Podium Green, and that link in time is what sets this bottle apart from a simple co branded label.

evidence.title: マクラーレンF1のオスカー・ピアストリ、マーク・ウェーバーとのマネジメント契約を解消。双方合意で関係に終止符
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 双方合意で関係に終止符 11/10(火) 10:43 配信 ピアストリとウェーバー（Getty Images） オスカー・ピアストリ（マクラーレン）とマーク・ウェーバーは、マネジメント契約を双方合意のもとで終了することを発表した。 [e005:f02] 【ハイライト】F1第20戦 サンパウロGP 決勝 ウェーバーとその妻アンがピアストリのマネジメントを始めたのは、2019年。 [e005:f03] 彼がルノーF1のアカデミー入りを果たした年だった。 [e005:f04] 翌2020年にはテオ・プルシェールとローガン・サージェントとの激しい戦いを制してFIA F3のタイトルを獲得し、2021年にはルーキーながらFIA F2で圧倒的な強さでタイトルを獲得した。 [e005:f05] またウェーバーのマネジメントのもと、ピアストリはキャリアを左右する決断を下した。 [e005:f06] アルピーヌ陣営を離れ、2023年シーズンからマクラーレンのレースシートを獲得したのだ。 [e005:f07] この移籍が、2025年のタイトル争いにつながる道を開いた。 [e005:f08] ピアストリはポールポジション6回、優勝9回を記録している。 [e005:f09] マネジメント契約の終了という節目にあたって、ウェーバーは次のようにコメントした。 [e005:f10] 「オスカーのキャリア形成期に重要な役割を果たし、彼がF1に進出して早い段階からトップ争いに加われるようにできたことを誇りに思う」 「今シーズン、我々がサーキット現場での関与を縮小したことを受け、マネジメント契約を終了するには今が適切なタイミングだということで、双方合意に至った。 [e005:f11] オスカーが長く、成功に満ちたキャリアとなることを願っている」 ウェーバーが言及しているように、2026年シーズンの開幕時点で彼は一歩引き、サーキット現場でピアストリをサポートすることはなくなっていた。 [e005:f12] これからの2人の活躍を願っている」 なおピアストリは以前、ウェーバーが現場に出なくなっていても関係は良好であり、その変化はF1での経験を積むにつれて、役割が変化してきたことによるものだと語っていた。 [e005:f13] 僕が初めてF1に来た頃、マークは僕の頭にはまったく浮かんでいなかったような質問やアイデアを次々と出してきた。 [e005:f14] 今はF1で4年目を迎えようとしているけど、最初の2年間なら答えられなかったような質問にも答えられるようになった。 [e005:f15] ここ数年で変わったのは、そういう部分なんだと思う」 Benjamin Vinel 【関連リンク】 ■F1ピアストリとMotoGPアコスタがオフロードバギーで対決！ [e005:f16] しかしボッタスは残留を確信「僕の力を、分かってくれる人は分かっている」 ■1980年F1王者アラン・ジョーンズが80歳で亡くなる。

evidence.title: 2027年デビュー、マクラーレン『MCL-HY』の最後のドライバー決定。プジョーからヤコブセンが加入
evidence.body: [e001:f01] プジョーからヤコブセンが加入 マクラーレン・エンデュランス・レーシングは、WEC世界耐久選手権ハイパーカークラスへの初参戦に向けたドライバーラインアップを確定。 [e001:f02] マクラーレンの新型LMDh『MCL-HY』を駆る6人目のドライバーとして、マルテ・ヤコブセンの加入を11月9日に正式発表した。 [e001:f03] デンマーク出身のヤコブセンは、数カ月前からプジョーを離れてマクラーレンへ移籍するのではないかと噂されていたが、プジョーでの活動を今シーズン限りで終了することが正式に確認されたのは、先週末にモンツァで開催されたシーズン最終戦のわずか1週間前のことだった。 [e001:f04] ヤコブセンは過去2年間、プジョーのドライバー陣の一員として活動し、2025年にはサーキット・オブ・ジ・アメリカズで表彰台を獲得した。 [e001:f05] また、それ以前の2シーズンはプジョーのテスト兼リザーブドライバーを務めていた。 [e001:f06] 彼は18歳だった2022年に、クール・レーシングからELMSヨーロピアン・ル・マン・シリーズのLMP3クラスでタイトルを獲得し、スポーツカーレースの世界で急速に頭角を現した。 [e001:f07] ヤコブセンは、マクラーレンのドライバーラインアップにおける最後のメンバーとなる。 [e001:f08] 同じく元プジョーのミケル・イェンセンをはじめ、長年ポルシェで活躍したローレンス・ファントール、元キャデラックのアレックス・リン、そしてマクラーレン・ドライバー・デベロップメント・プログラムのメンバーであるレオナルド・フォルナローリとグレゴワール・ソーシーが、2027年のドライバーとしてすでに発表済みだ。 [e001:f09] 記事に関するキーワード マクラーレン デンマーク FIA世界耐久選手権 F1 提供元の記事 （外部サイトに移動します）。

evidence.title: Pepperstone and Aston Martin Aramco extend and expand partnership with Fernando Alonso
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Melbourne, Australia (ANTARA/PRNewswire)- Pepperstone, the global online trading provider, and the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One™ Team are extending and enhancing their partnership, with two-time Formula One™ World Champion Fernando Alonso appointed as a global ambassador for Pepperstone from 2027. [e003:f02] Pepperstone strengthens its partnership with the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One™ Team, unveiling an expanded presence and a new global ambassador partnership with two-time Formula One™ World Champion Fernando Alonso from 2027. [e003:f03] The expanded partnership will be celebrated at the Mexico City Grand Prix this coming weekend, where Fernando will race with a specially designed Pepperstone helmet, bringing the collaboration to life on one of Formula One's most vibrant global stages. [e003:f04] Since its inception in 2025, the partnership has been built around the shared philosophy that better decisions come from experience, trust and an unwavering attention to detail. [e003:f05] Whether navigating the complexities of global financial markets or competing at the pinnacle of motorsport, success demands the ability to analyse information, challenge assumptions and identify the smallest opportunities to improve. [e003:f06] With more than two decades of experience competing at the highest level of motorsport, Fernando embodies the value of experience, instinct and meticulous preparation. [e003:f07] His relentless pursuit of excellence and refusal to settle for anything less than his best make him a natural ambassador for Pepperstone and its belief that Better Never Settles. [e003:f08] Throughout my career I've learned that you never stop looking for ways to improve, whether that's understanding the car, analysing data or making decisions under pressure," said Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team driver and Pepperstone Global Ambassador. [e003:f09] "That's why I connect with the partnership's Better Never Settles philosophy. [e003:f10] It's about trusting your preparation, using your experience and always looking for that next improvement. [e003:f11] I'm excited to become a global ambassador for Pepperstone and to celebrate the partnership with a special helmet in Mexico this weekend." The expanded partnership comes as Pepperstone continues to grow its global business, investing in technology, broadening its product offering and strengthening its presence across core markets and growth regions. [e003:f12] "Welcoming Fernando Alonso as our global ambassador is an exciting next chapter in our partnership with Aston Martin Aramco. [e003:f13] His relentless drive to improve embodies Pepperstone's belief that Better Never Settles," said Tamas Szabo, Group CEO of Pepperstone. [e003:f14] "We're focused on expanding our products, advancing our technology and growing our global presence as we build one of the world's most trusted fintech ecosystems. [e003:f15] And this expanded global partnership with Aston Martin Aramco supports that ambition, strengthening our connection with audiences around the world, including in Latin America, an important growth region for Pepperstone." About Pepperstone Pepperstone is a global fintech and CFD broker serving traders in more than 160 countries. [e003:f16] The company provides access to forex, indices, commodities, shares, ETFs and digital asset markets through industry-leading platforms, competitive pricing and a strong regulatory framework.

ロバート・クビサ AFコルセ離脱を発表 ル・マン制覇の黄色いフェラーリに別れ
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 2025年のル・マン24時間レースで総合優勝を果たしたポーランド人ドライバーが、3シーズンにわたって戦った黄色いフェラーリ499Pに別れを告げる。 [e005:f02] 元F1ドライバーのクビサは、2024年からAFコルセの83号車フェラーリ499PでWECハイパーカークラスに参戦。 [e005:f03] 2025年にはル・マン24時間レースで歴史的な総合優勝を達成したが、2026年シーズンをもってチームを去ることになった。 [e005:f04] クビサ「黄色いフェラーリでの最後のレースだった」 クビサは11月8日、WEC最終戦モンツァ6時間レースを終えた後、自身のInstagramを通じてAFコルセからの離脱を表明した。 [e005:f05] また近いうちに会おう」 このメッセージによって、クビサが2027年にAFコルセの83号車フェラーリ499Pをドライブしないことが明らかになった。 [e005:f06] クビサは2024年、フェラーリのカスタマーチームであるAFコルセに加入。 [e005:f07] フェラーリのワークスチームが使用する赤いカラーリングとは異なり、83号車は黄色を基調としたカラーリングを採用。 [e005:f08] クビサがドライブする「黄色いフェラーリ」は、WECを象徴するマシンのひとつとなった。 [e005:f09] クビサはイェ・イーフェイ、フィリップ・ハンソンとともに83号車フェラーリ499Pをドライブし、世界最高峰の耐久レースを制覇。 [e005:f10] フェラーリにル・マン24時間レース3年連続総合優勝をもたらした。 [e005:f11] この勝利は、2006年から2010年にかけてF1に参戦し、2011年のラリー事故によってキャリアを大きく変えられたクビサにとって、特別な意味を持つものだった。 [e005:f12] 長いリハビリを経て2019年にF1復帰を果たしたクビサは、その後スポーツカーレースに活動の場を移し、2021年にはル・マン24時間レースのLMP2クラスで優勝目前まで迫ったものの、最終周にマシントラブルで勝利を逃していた。 [e005:f13] それから4年後、フェラーリ499Pでル・マンの頂点に立ち、モータースポーツ界における復活劇を完成させた。 [e005:f14] クビサはフェラーリのワークス契約ドライバーではなく、AFコルセと直接契約していた。 [e005:f15] そのため、今回の決定はフェラーリのワークスドライバー体制からの離脱とは異なる。 [e005:f16] F1で1勝を挙げ、ラリーでの大事故から復帰し、さらにル・マン24時間レース総合優勝という偉業を成し遂げたクビサ。

evidence.body: [e008:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e008:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e008:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e008:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e008:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e008:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e008:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e008:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e008:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e008:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e008:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 15 Targets Nov. 13 Launch Window
evidence.body: [e002:f01] With Booster 22 now in position, the Starship stack is one step closer to being fully integrated with Ship 42 for the upcoming flight test. ▶ @RGVaerialphotos — Booster 22 on launch mount ▶ @CSI_Starbase — "Booster 22 is ready for launch! [e002:f02] " SpaceX has issued official launch advisories for Starship Flight 15, targeting a liftoff window on Friday, November 13, 2026, from Orbital Launch Pad 2 at Starbase, Texas. [e002:f03] If the mission goes as planned, it would mark the first time an orbital launch system has been fully recovered — both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage returning to the launch tower for a mechanical catch. [e002:f04] Source: @LabPadre — November 9, 2026 The Windows According to the advisory tracked by @LabPadre, the launch window opens at 4:45 p.m. [e002:f05] The reentry window — when Ship 42 would return to the launch site for its catch attempt — falls the following day, November 14, between 2:56 p.m. and 6:14 p.m. [e002:f06] Source: @LabPadre — November 9, 2026 What Flight 15 Is Attempting This is not a routine test hop. [e002:f07] According to SpaceX, Flight 15 carries three simultaneous objectives that, taken together, represent the most ambitious Starship mission to date. [e002:f08] Second, and most consequential for the broader launch industry, both vehicles are targeting a return to the launch site. [e002:f09] If both catches succeed, SpaceX would have demonstrated a fully reusable orbital launch stack — a milestone the industry has been building toward since the first Starship integrated flight test in April 2023. [e002:f10] The launch remains pending regulatory approval, and SpaceX has noted the schedule is dynamic — meaning the November 13 target could shift if the FAA has not issued a launch license in time. [e002:f11] Flight 15 is asking whether SpaceX can close the loop entirely — land both halves of the rocket at the pad, refurbish them, and fly again. [e002:f12] Deploying 26 satellites on a test vehicle signals that SpaceX is confident enough in Starship's reliability to risk operational hardware — and that the program is transitioning from pure R&D to operational service. [e002:f13] For more on SpaceX's broader launch cadence and program milestones, see our SpaceX coverage . [e002:f14] See every test flight, official outcome and the next launch window in our SpaceX Starship Tracker . evidence.title: Elon Musk dares SpaceX investors to dream big
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Weeks after floating an eye popping revenue range for SpaceX, he finally said which end of it he actually had in mind. [e004:f02] 20 earnings call, Musk said annual recurring revenue by the end of 2027 would land somewhere between $500 billion and $1 trillion. [e004:f03] The measure is a yearly pace based on a single month, in this case December. [e004:f04] At an investor conference on Nov. [e004:f05] He said topping $500 billion in December 2027 looked likely and described it as his best guess, not a promise. [e004:f06] A $1 trillion pace, he added, remained possible, though he put the odds at about 2%. [e004:f07] Even the low end is five times the $100 billion yearly pace SpaceX expects to reach this December, which raises an obvious question about how fast a business this large can grow. [e004:f08] Third quarter revenue reached about $14.6 billion, a jump of roughly 161% from a year earlier. [e004:f09] Looking ahead, the finance chief guided for $33 billion to $37 billion in the first quarter of 2027, which would be a major leap on its own. [e004:f10] Reaching a $500 billion pace by next December from the midpoint of that guidance would require roughly 45% to 50% growth in every quarter left in 2027. [e004:f11] Musk has floated a range of $30 to $50 per watt for computing, and the company has said recent pricing runs slightly above that. [e004:f12] Its cloud contracts can generally be canceled with 90 days’ notice, so pricing may not hold, and at $30 per watt, 13 gigawatts would bring in around $390 billion. [e004:f13] What the valuation already reflects SpaceX carries a market value of roughly $2 trillion, so investors are already paying for plenty of growth. [e004:f14] If the company did reach a $500 billion pace and held the 19% operating margin it reported last quarter, it would earn around $96 billion a year in operating income, or about $76 billion after a 21% tax rate. [e004:f15] That multiple would be fair for a fast growing giant, though it would leave little room for error, and it ignores the cost of getting there. [e004:f16] Musk’s own framing may be the most telling detail.
